text:
🚨 JD Vance says Republicans' midterm losses were partly due to US support for Israel.

The Vice President's remark adds a new layer after earlier reports that he blamed the Iran war for the defeat.

via warsurv

🚨 Beirut does not trust Hezbollah and Iranian assurances that the group will sit out a renewed US Iran war.

A Lebanese official opposed to Hezbollah says the decision is not made by Naim Qassem but in Tehran.

"At this stage, the Lebanese state does not have the ability to prevent Hezbollah from firing at Israel."

via OSINT613, citing Kan News

🚨 Trump warns Democrats against impeachment.

"It would destroy the Democrat Party if they did that. Impeachment for no reason. For what, having a successful country?"

via OSINT613

🚨 Senior Iranian MP Ebrahim Azizi: "Democrats or Republicans, it's all the same to us."

Azizi says Trump's "miscalculations" on Iran have made him the most failed president in US history, and that Tehran's strategic doctrine stays unyielding until Washington meets Iran's baseline conditions.

via OSINT613

Trump blames the GOP midterm losses on not being on the ballot himself.

He also says he is willing to work with Democrats in the new Congress.

via warsurv

🚨 Trump on Iran: "I would have done nothing different."

President Trump doubles down on the Iran war, saying he has no regrets and would do it again, despite JD Vance reportedly blaming the conflict for the Republican midterm losses.

He says Iran's navy, air force and air defenses are gone.

via Fox News

🚨 Trump says he is not concerned about impeachment.

The President brushed off the threat a day after Democrats won control of both the House and the Senate.

via warsurv

Al Qaeda linked Ansaru releases new training video in Nigeria.

Fighters of Jama'atu Ansarul Muslimina fi Biladis Sudan appear armed with AK 103 pattern assault rifles, PKM machine guns and AKM or Type 56 rifles.

via war_noir

🚨 Trump asks an adviser whether Pete Hegseth should stay on as Defense Secretary.

Hours after reports he was weighing a move, Trump reportedly added: "He's doing a great job after all."

via warsurv

Jeffries puts the White House on notice.

"We don't work for Donald Trump, JD Vance or the Supreme Court. We work for the American people," says House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries, adding that he has not heard from President Trump.

via OSINT613

Saudi Arabia and Syria sign a military cooperation agreement.

Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman and Syrian President Ahmed al Sharaa attended the signing of the new defense deal between the two countries.

via OSINT613

🚨 Trump: the Iran war will end when I want it to.

President Trump says he will decide when the war with Iran is over, adding "it has to be done right."

via OSINT613

Trump on the new Congress: "I'll get along probably with the Democrats."

via OSINT613

Trump stays neutral in the House GOP leadership fight.

With Steve Scalise and Jim Jordan both in the race, President Trump says he is not picking a side. "The Speaker was fantastic... all good people. Right now, you have 2 candidates."

via OSINT613

🚨 US sanctions Indian and Turkish firms for aiding Iran.

Washington has slapped sanctions on companies and individuals in India and Turkey accused of helping Iran.

via Reuters

🚨 Active shooter reported at a Citibank in East Tampa, Florida.

via OSINT613 https://t.co/y138yCmk4U

🚨 Trump: the Iran war cost us the election, and it was worth it.

Asked about the midterm losses, President Trump says it is "largely true" that the defeat was a result of the Iran war, but insists it was worth it. "The Iran thing we had to do, we continue to do it."

via OSINT613

🚨 Houthis down a Saudi operated drone over Taiz.

Ansar Allah says it shot down a drone flown by Saudi forces over Yemen's Taiz Governorate. It appears to be a Chinese made Wing Loong II armed with at least one air to ground guided missile.

via war_noir https://t.co/9CPJB88JDI

Texas Democrat James Talarico says he wants to work with President Trump to bring relief to working Texans in the middle of the affordability crisis.

His idea: suspend the federal gas and diesel taxes for immediate relief at the pump.

via OSINT613

Trump touts another record high on Wall Street.

President Trump says the stock market has hit its 91st record high in less than two years, adding that Americans' 401(k) retirement accounts are "through the roof."

via OSINT613
